detail.ja: サイズ最適化版を書き込み、起動・mem・ps・lsを確認。全機能回帰は未実施。
detail.en: Size-optimized firmware flashed; boot, mem, ps and ls verified. Full regression pending.

detail.ja: 独自DMA版で37・512・8192バイトの読み書き・再起動後保持を確認。再接続処理も修正し、I/O停止中の抜き差し1回で再マウント、既存全内容一致、新規512バイトの読み書きを確認。TinyUSBは比較用。受信機の直接接続と高速ハブ経由の入力も確認済み。Buffer DMA切替後のストレージ読み書き回帰試験は残件。
detail.en: Native DMA verified: 37, 512 and 8192 byte write/read and persistence. Reconnection corrected; one idle unplug/replug cycle passed remount, full original-file readback and a new 512-byte write/read. TinyUSB retained for comparison. Receiver input passed both directly and through a High-Speed hub. Storage write/read regression after the Buffer DMA conversion remains pending.

detail.ja: SPI接続、/sd FATマウント、一覧取得、新規38バイト書き込み・読み戻し・再起動後保持、/usbとの同時マウントを実機確認。高速化・抜き差しは未検証。
detail.en: Verified on hardware: SPI access, /sd FAT mount, listing, 38-byte test file write/read and persistence after reset, simultaneous /usb mount. Speed optimization and hot-plug unverified.

title.ja: 3. USBハブ・複数メモリ・キーボード併用
title.en: 3. USB hubs, multiple drives and keyboard coexistence

detail.ja: 独自Buffer DMAへ統一し、高速ハブ配下のFull-Speed無線受信機をスプリット転送で認識。入力レポート・シェル実行をログとユーザー操作で確認。USBメモリ2本のマウント、Ethernet ping 10/10も確認。診断表示は削除。新方式での読み書き併用試験は、接続機器がなくなったため未確認。従来方式では2本のCRC付き読み書きを確認済み。
detail.en: Unified the native host on Buffer DMA and added split transfers for a Full-Speed wireless receiver beneath a High-Speed hub. Reports and shell commands were verified in logs and by the user; two drives mounted and Ethernet ping passed 10/10. Diagnostics removed. New-engine write/read coexistence remains unverified because USB devices were absent during the attempt. Earlier CRC write/read results apply to the previous engine.

detail.ja: RTL8153 CDC-ECMでリンク・DHCP・ping・SSHを実機確認。MSCのDMA待機中にUSBロックを解放し、USBメモリ2本の読み書きとping併用で各20/20応答、USBエラー・ドロップ0。長時間試験と抜き差し時の通信継続は未確認。
detail.en: RTL8153 CDC-ECM passed hardware link, DHCP, ping and SSH. Releasing the USB lock during MSC DMA waits enabled reads/writes on both drives alongside 20/20 ping replies per test with zero USB errors or drops. Long-duration and hot-plug continuity tests remain pending.

detail.ja: C6を公式MCUアプリへSDIO更新。再起動後の維持、Wi-Fi初期化・検索・WPA2接続・DHCPを確認。LANケーブルを抜きEthernet非アクティブの状態で、Wi-FiによるDNS名前解決とHTTP 200受信を実機確認。長時間通信と再接続試験は未実施。
detail.en: Updated C6 over SDIO to the official MCU application. Reset persistence, Wi-Fi initialization, scanning, WPA2 association and DHCP passed. With Ethernet unplugged and inactive, Wi-Fi DNS resolution and HTTP 200 retrieval passed on hardware. Long-duration traffic and reconnect tests remain pending.

title.ja: 4. SSHサーバー・クライアント同時動作

detail.ja: 共有コンソールへ接続するSSHサーバーを実装。実機で認証・コマンド実行・再接続・停止と、接続維持中のSSHクライアント実行を確認。Web/TailscaleとはTCP枠を分離。独立PTY・exec・SFTPは未実装。
detail.en: Shared-console SSH server implemented. Hardware authentication, commands, reconnect, stop and outbound SSH while keeping inbound SSH active passed. TCP slots are separate from Web/Tailscale. Independent PTYs, exec and SFTP are not implemented.

detail.ja: LCD/SSHに256色・RGB、スクロール領域、行挿入削除、カーソル保存復元、代替画面等を実装。SSHは問い合わせ応答とDECCKM、Vimキー透過も追加。実parserのホスト検証済み。実機Vim/SLの通し確認と完全なVT220/xterm互換は未達。
detail.en: LCD/SSH implement 256/RGB colors, scroll margins, line edits, cursor save/restore and alternate screens. SSH adds DSR, DECCKM and Vim key passthrough. Actual-parser host tests passed; device Vim/SL end-to-end checks and full VT220/xterm compatibility remain pending.

title.ja: 5. タッチ入力・コンソールスクロール

detail.ja: 256行の色付き履歴とスワイプ操作を実装。初回実機試験は反応せず、GT911専用入力ドライバーが新ST7121パネルを認識しない原因を特定。ST7123互換入力を追加し、実機再検証中。
detail.en: 256-line colored history and swipe handling implemented. Initial device swipe failed because the GT911-only input driver did not recognize the ST7121 panel. ST7123-compatible input added; device recheck pending.

detail.ja: C6経路を調査し、BLE HIDの探索・ペアリング・再接続・入力を実装。Classicは別途可否確認。
detail.en: Audit C6 transport; implement BLE HID discovery, pairing, reconnect and input. Assess Classic separately.

detail.ja: 独自USB DMAドライバへUVC列挙・映像転送・バッファ管理を追加。機器に応じてバルク／アイソクロナス転送、MJPEG／非圧縮形式を調査。低解像度から表示・保存・抜き差しを検証。
detail.en: Add UVC enumeration, video transport and buffers to the native USB DMA driver. Audit bulk/isochronous transfers and MJPEG/uncompressed formats per device. Verify preview, capture and hot-plug at low resolution first.

detail.ja: SC202CS／MIPI-CSI／ISPの既存ドライバと撮影アプリを実機検証。初期化・プレビュー・保存・終了時の資源解放を確認し、不足を修正。USBカメラとの共通アプリAPIも検討。
detail.en: Validate the existing SC202CS/MIPI-CSI/ISP driver and camera app on hardware. Check initialization, preview, capture and cleanup; fix gaps. Evaluate a common application API with USB cameras.
